entries.en: You used to be afraid of Saul.
Fantastic. We have everything hooked up and nothing works.
entries.ro: Fantastic. Am legat tot și nimic nu merge.

entries.en: It works, though not reliably. V, could scan it?
entries.ro: Merge, da' nu fiabil. V, poți să-l scanezi?

entries.en: Capacitor's damaged. Third from the right.
entries.ro: Condensatorul e avariat. Al treilea din dreapta.

entries.en: Hm, indeed. Hold on, let me swap it out.
Because I am not open to the prospect of taking it all apart again.
entries.ro: Că n-am chef să-l desfac iar.

entries.en: Even if we pull it off, Saul will be pissed.
entries.ro: Chiar dacă reușim, Saul o să se enerveze rău.

entries.en: I can see his face already.
'Member when we first met? Almost had a pound in your pants at the thought of falling foul of Saul.
entries.ro: Ții minte când ne-am cunoscut? Ți-era cât pe ce să-ți faci pe tine doar gândindu-te că te pui cu Saul.

entries.en: I don't recall leaving Panam high and dry, though.
entries.ro: Nu mi-amintesc să fi lăsat-o pe Panam baltă, da'.

entries.en: Now you're gonna stick it to 'im plain. Something change?
entries.ro: Acum chiar îi dai peste bot. S-a schimbat ceva?

entries.en: Uh-huh. I realized Panam is right.
entries.ro: Aha. Mi-am dat seama că Panam are dreptate.
